Woods changed his earlier not-guilty plea after prosecutors reduced the DUI charge to reckless driving. Woods was arrested March 27 after his Land Rover clipped a trailer being hauled by a truck and rolled onto its side on Jupiter Island, Florida, north of Palm Beach. An arrest report said Woods had been traveling at high speed on a residential road with a 30 mph speed limit and caused about $5,000 in damage. item.title: Trump's White House Ballroom Is a Monument to His Lawlessness
item.description:

When President Donald Trump demolished the East Wing last fall, by contrast, he acted without permission from Congress, which the Constitution empowers to control federal property.
